title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Key Account Manager to manage, nurture, and grow existing client relationships with HBX Group. This role is essential in ensuring client satisfaction, driving account performance, and identifying opportunities for incremental growth. You will be responsible for client onboarding, operational optimization, and ongoing engagement, while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with assigned key accounts.
  • Conduct regular client meetings, monthly performance reviews, and reporting.
  • Serve as the main point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues and alignment with client goals.


Account Activation & Optimization

  • Understand client operations across departments (e.g., tech, pricing, mapping).
  • Support onboarding of new products and services using Salesforce and Salesloft.
  • Monitor account performance and implement optimization strategies for distribution and pricing.


Growth & Retention

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on client needs and market trends.
  • Build rapport across various levels of the client’s organization.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery of client-specific solutions and improvements.


Required Skills

  • Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities.
  • Commercial acumen and consultative selling approach.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive decisions.
  • Proactive, customer-focused, and results-oriented.


Required Tech Skills

  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Salesloft, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Basic understanding of API functionality and travel tech platforms.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years in account management, sales, or client services.
  • Fluent in English and source market language (essential).
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for client visits and meetings.
  • Experience in matrixed organizations and tech-enabled environments.
  • Background in travel, financial services, or related industries is a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.

This role is essential in ensuring client satisfaction, driving account performance, and identifying opportunities for incremental growth. You will be responsible for client onboarding, operational optimization, and ongoing engagement, while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with assigned key accounts.
  • Conduct regular client meetings, monthly performance reviews, and reporting.
  • Serve as the main point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues and alignment with client goals.


Account Activation & Optimization

  • Understand client operations across departments (e.g., tech, pricing, mapping).
  • Support onboarding of new products and services using Salesforce and Salesloft.
  • Monitor account performance and implement optimization strategies for distribution and pricing.


Growth & Retention

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on client needs and market trends.
  • Build rapport across various levels of the client’s organization.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery of client-specific solutions and improvements.


Required Skills

  • Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities.
  • Commercial acumen and consultative selling approach.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive decisions.
  • Proactive, customer-focused, and results-oriented.


Required Tech Skills

  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Salesloft, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Basic understanding of API functionality and travel tech platforms.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years in account management, sales, or client services.
  • Fluent in English and source market language (essential).
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for client visits and meetings.
  • Experience in matrixed organizations and tech-enabled environments.
  • Background in travel, financial services, or related industries is a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior (Remoto)
description:
Ola!


A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Estamos em busca de um (a) Engenheiro (a) de Software com IA para projetar, desenvolver e evoluir soluções que utilizam Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, atuando de ponta a ponta, da concepção técnica até a implementação em produção.

Essa pessoa trabalhará em conjunto com times de produto, dados e negócios para transformar desafios reais em soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alto impacto.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações de software que incorporem modelos de IA e Machine Learning;
  • Integrar modelos de IA a sistemas existentes, APIs, pipelines de dados e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de dados na construção, treinamento, versionamento e deploy de modelos;
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps, garantindo automação, monitoramento, rastreabilidade e escalabilidade dos modelos em produção;
  • Desenvolver soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) como chatbots, sistemas de recomendação, classificação, busca semântica e automação inteligente;
  • Garantir qualidade de código, segurança, performance e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Participar de decisões de arquitetura, revisões técnicas e definição de padrões;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua das soluções, avaliando métricas de performance dos modelos e do software;
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e compartilhar conhecimento com o time.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (backend e/ou full stack);
  • Proficiência em linguagens como Python, Java, Go, JavaScript ou TypeScript;
  • Experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas de IA e Machine Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain ou Hugging Face);
  • Conhecimento em APIs, microserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Experiência com cloud computing (Google Cloud ou Azure);
  • Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática com LLMs, GenAI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de dados como Databricks, BigQuery ou Spark;
  • Experiência com MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow ou Vertex AI);
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA e governança de dados;
  • Experiência prévia em produtos digitais orientados a dados.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de dono;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Comunicação clara e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade técnica;
  • Curiosidade e atualização constante sobre novas tecnologias de IA.

title: NodeJS Developer w/NextJS - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of professional experience as Software Developer;
  • 3+ years of professional experience with NodeJS;
  • 2 + years of professional experience with NextJS;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory);
  • Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: P2P Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

• Global Scale: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets.

• Industry Leader: Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, supporting a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets.

• Our Team: Backed by thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally.

• Our Culture: We operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments.


About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented P2P Merchant Operations Manager to join our dynamic operations team. In this role, you will be a key driver of our P2P ecosystem, focusing on nurturing relationships with existing platform merchants, expanding our network by onboarding new high-quality merchant clients, and maintaining platform integrity through careful application reviews and market research. If you are a proactive team player with a deep understanding of the crypto P2P landscape and the resilience to thrive under pressure, we'd love to have you on board.


Responsibilities:

1. Maintain relationships with merchants and users on the platform.

2. Develop and expand new merchant clients.

3. Review and approve merchant applications.

4. Conduct market research.

5. Assist with other related operational tasks.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 2 years of relevant P2P work experience in the cryptocurrency industry.

2. Familiar with internet platform resource management processes and possess basic data analysis skills.

3. Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

4. Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work well under pressure.

title: Analista de Negócios – Experiência do Cliente & Inteligência de Negócios
description:
O Analista de Negócios é responsável pelo desenvolvimento de dashboards Power BI de nível empresarial e análises Salesforce que impulsionam a excelência operacional, o crescimento da receita, a rentabilidade dos serviços e a tomada de decisões executivas. Essa função atua como o motor de dados e insights para as áreas de Serviço de Campo, Suporte Técnico, Atendimento ao Cliente, Treinamento e Gerenciamento de Projetos.

CONHECIMENTO

  • Administração e Gestão — Conhecimento dos princípios de negócios e gestão envolvidos no planejamento estratégico, alocação de recursos, modelagem de recursos humanos, técnicas de liderança, métodos de produção e coordenação de pessoas e recursos.
  • Economia e Contabilidade — Conhecimento dos princípios e práticas econômicas e contábeis, dos mercados financeiros, do sistema bancário e da análise e divulgação de dados financeiros.
  • Lígua Inglesa - Para está vaga é necessario inglês (avançado), pois haverá interação com todas as empresas do grupo.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.


If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.


We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.


The impact you'll make:


  • Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
  • Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
  • Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
  • Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.
  • Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence


Technology Stack:


  • Go (Golang)
  • Blockchain


What you'll bring to us:


  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
  • Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
  • Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
  • Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
  • Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
  • Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, EdDSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
  • Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro.



Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy working with us:


  • The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
  • The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A flexible and remote working environment.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto especificam suas necessidades de TI na Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na próxima vaga: Engenheiro de Dados/ML Especialista - Remoto

O que oferecer a você

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;
  • Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota;
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;
  • Creche Auxílio;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino;
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas;
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;
  • Programa de prazo: prêmio para prazo bem sucedido;
  • Licença maternidade prolongada de 180 dias e licença paternidade de 20 dias;
  • Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;
  • GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, ganhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!

O que esperar dessa posição

Um especialista sênior que liderou a criação e gestão dos pipelines de dados que alimentam os modelos analíticos do projeto. Você será responsável por garantir a qualidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos dados para treinamento e inferência dos modelos de Machine Learning em produção. Esperamos que você oriente outros membros da equipe e defina estratégias de engenharia de dados e MLOps. Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você

  • Machine Learning: Profundo conhecimento em algoritmos de Machine Learning e na construção de modelos analíticos de ponta a ponta.
  • Engenharia de Dados: Ampla experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) com ferramentas como Apache Spark, Airflow ou similares.
  • Programação e Bibliotecas: Domínio de Python e suas bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy) e ML (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).
  • MLOps: Experiência liderando a implementação de práticas de MLOps para versionamento, monitoramento e retreinamento automatizado de modelos.
  • Big Data: Habilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em ecossistemas de Big Data (Data Lakes, Data Warehouses).


O que fazer em seguida

Caso você seja uma pessoa que está procurando, aguarde nosso contato para conhecê-lo melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.



Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos com duas posições abertas para Desenvolvedor Java Sênior, com foco em refatoração e evolução de sistemas. Buscamos profissionais com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento Full Stack e capacidade de contribuir tecnicamente em iniciativas de modernização, melhoria de performance, segurança e escalabilidade.


Responsabilidades

• Atuar em iniciativas de refatoração e melhoria contínua de sistemas legados e/ou em evolução

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend escaláveis, seguras e performáticas

• Construir e manter APIs RESTful com foco em segurança e eficiência

• Contribuir com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, padrões de design e clean code

• Realizar code reviews e apoiar desenvolvedores menos experientes

• Trabalhar em parceria com times de QA, DevOps e demais stakeholders


Requisitos técnicos indispensáveis

• Java 8 ou superior, com domínio de concorrência, multithreading, lambdas e streams

• Experiência sólida com Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security e Hibernate

• Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços

• Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente Oracle e SQL

• Criação e consumo de APIs REST

• Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando JUnit e Mockito

• Git e boas práticas de versionamento, como GitFlow

• Conhecimento em React e ou Angular


Diferenciais

• Experiência com cloud computing, como AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud

• Vivência com ambientes de deploy, monitoramento e escalabilidade em nuvem

• Experiência com bancos de dados não relacionais


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Tech Lead | AI Platform & Agents
description:
Procuramos uma pessoa Tech Lead de AI Platform & Agents para liderar tecnicamente a construção de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa, arquiteturas de agentes e sistemas inteligentes aplicados ao produto.

Essa posição terá papel estratégico na evolução da arquitetura de IA da Sankhya, conectando modelos de linguagem, contexto de dados e automação de decisões para resolver problemas reais de negócio em escala.

Buscamos alguém que combine profundidade técnica em GenAI, visão arquitetural e liderança hands-on, atuando próximo ao time, produto e arquitetura para construir plataformas de inteligência que integrem IA ao core das soluções da empresa.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

● Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa e arquiteturas de agentes aplicadas ao produto

● Definir padrões e arquitetura para sistemas inteligentes, pipelines de GenAI e workflows de agentes

● Apoiar o time na construção de RAGs, agentes autônomos e mecanismos de contexto (MCPs)

● Atuar hands-on em iniciativas técnicas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade

● Traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções baseadas em IA aplicada e automação inteligente

● Definir boas práticas de engenharia para integração de LLMs com sistemas corporativos

● Liderar experimentação e evolução de provas de conceito de IA aplicada ao produto

● Garantir qualidade técnica através de code review, testes e observabilidade de sistemas de IA

● Monitorar performance, qualidade e riscos de soluções baseadas em modelos de IA

● Mentorar e desenvolver o time técnico, apoiando evolução de carreira e maturidade de engenharia

● Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e arquitetura, apoiando decisões técnicas estratégicas


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Experiência essencial

● Experiência sólida com IA Generativa aplicada a produto

● Experiência com arquiteturas de agentes e workflows de LLMs

● Vivência prática com RAG, embeddings e vector databases

● Experiência com frameworks de agentes como LangChain, LangGraph ou similares

● Experiência integrando LLMs via APIs ou plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock)

● Experiência colocando sistemas de IA ou ML em produção

● Forte experiência com Python para backend

● Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica

Experiência complementar

● Conhecimento em Machine Learning tradicional

● Experiência com engenharia de dados e pipelines de dados

● Experiência com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos

● Vivência com governança de dados ou plataformas de dados em escala


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT


BENEFÍCIOS

Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: LAB Quality System Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for LAB Quality System Engineer .


In this role you will:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation of solutions and contribute to overall project success. The role requires a proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a strong foundation in the life sciences and manufacturing engineering domain, with a focus on MES systems.

  • Perform independently and progressively grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for MES applications.
  • Actively participate and contribute to team discussions, planning, and technical evaluations.
  • Propose and deliver practical solutions to business and technical problems.
  • Design, develop, and implement software solutions aligned with business requirements and compliance needs.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, QA teams, and project stakeholders to deliver robust application solutions.
  • Conduct and participate in peer code reviews; provide constructive feedback to uphold development standards.
  • Remain current on application development trends, MES technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Support the troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues in the MES environment.


We have some requirements:

  • Proficiency in Manufacturing Engineering MES, with a strong background in Syncade MES.
  • Deep understanding of the Life Sciences domain, specifically in regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and validated system environments.
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks and sprint-based development processes.
  • Solid knowledge of database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle).
  • Hands-on experience in application architecture, design patterns, and development practices.
  • Fluent English

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Developer with 5+ years of Delphi software development experience to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Implement software changes with the awareness and sensitivity of impact on the system as a whole
  • Learn and adhere to the adopted coding standards used by the software ERP Development Team
  • Leverage Delphi experience and learn all other client development tools
  • Monitor assigned software development change requests and implement changes for requests based on priority
  • Review requirements for system changes and enhancements, analyze those requests, and translate them into necessary programming changes
  • Perform necessary designing, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation (using the Delphi IDE and any other necessary tools)


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of Delphi and SQL Server experience (FireDAC experience is a plus)
  • Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (in addition to Delphi/Object Pascal) is a plus, e.g., Java, C#, C++, etc.
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)


Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry and any related applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning and management tools such as GitHub
  • Working with AI tools within the development workflow


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Data Engineer
description:
Required Skills & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

3–5 years of experience in data engineering roles.

At least 2 years of hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark.

Strong programming skills in Python.

Proficiency in SQL and experience working with both relational and non‑relational databases.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Azure certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate, or Databricks certifications.

Experience with streaming data processing (e.g., Structured Streaming, Event Hubs).

Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt or ARM templates).

Familiarity with data governance tools and practices.

Experience with Unity Catalog, data governance, and data security/compliance concepts.


Job Description


Insight Global is seeking a Data Engineer to support a large beverage company’s data and analytics initiatives. This delivery-focused role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks, including Unity Catalog. The Data Engineer will develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines and Apache Spark jobs, ensure data quality and reliability, and collaborate with product owners and analytics teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.


This is a remote role in Brazil.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis , essa vaga é para você.


Sobre a Tipspace

A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.


Tecnologias do Projeto

Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:

  • Bancos de Dados relacionais
  • Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
  • SQL para consultas estruturadas
  • Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
  • Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código


Responsabilidades

Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
  • Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
  • Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
  • Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
  • Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção.


Requisitos

Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:

  • Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
  • Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
  • Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
  • Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso.


Benefícios e Condições

  • Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).

title: Consultor(a) Comercial em Saúde — Consultas, Procedimentos e Cirurgias
description:
Consultor(a) Comercial em Saúde — Consultas, Procedimentos e Cirurgias (PJ | Hibrido - Zona Sul/SP)


Missão da Vaga:

Atuar de forma estratégica na conversão de leads em consultas, procedimentos e cirurgias, conduzindo o processo comercial de ponta a ponta, do primeiro contato ao fechamento.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com forte perfil comercial, focado(a) em resultados, capaz de realizar uma venda consultiva baseada em relacionamento, condução ativa, follow-ups estruturados e negociação eficiente.


Você será responsável por transformar demanda em faturamento, garantindo uma jornada fluida e segura para o paciente, desde o interesse inicial até a tomada de decisão.

Contará com o suporte do time de marketing da Atem, com fluxo contínuo de leads qualificados e materiais estratégicos, proporcionando maior previsibilidade e eficiência nas vendas.


Sobre a Atem

Somos uma assessoria de marketing digital em processo comercial especializada no setor da saúde. Nossa missão é alavancar as vendas de clínicas e médicos, oferecendo previsibilidade e constância no crescimento do faturamento. Atendemos uma variedade de especialistas, com soluções em tráfego pago, assessoria comercial e posicionamento digital estratégico.


Responsabilidades:


  • Comercial 1 — Abordagem & Qualificação: fazer o primeiro contato (prioridade para ligação; usar WhatsApp quando aplicável), diagnosticar dor, urgência, indicação e capacidade de pagamento; registrar no CRM e definir próxima ação/ prazo;


  • Agendamento & Show Rate: agendar consulta e garantir comparecimento com confirmações, lembretes, reencaixes e lista de espera; monitorar e melhorar show rate;


  • Comercial 2 — Proposta & Fechamento: apresentar e negociar orçamento conforme tabela de cada médico, alinhar expectativas e próximos passos; aplicar urgência/escassez de forma ética;


  • Comercial 2 – Agendamentos e conclusão da venda : Agendar com hospitais e prestadores que participarão do procedimento;


  • Venda de Relacionamento: construir vínculo empático, educar sobre a jornada (sem promessas clínicas) e contornar objeções;


  • Follow-ups & Reativações: executar cadência estruturada (ligação/WhatsApp/e-mail) até a decisão; retomar orçamentos vencidos e no-shows;


  • CRM & Rotinas: operar o Kommo com funis separados por médico, tarefas, motivos de perda e previsibilidade; usar ClickUp/planilhas para controles específicos;


  • Integração com Clínicas: alinhar datas cirúrgicas com cada equipe;


  • Treinos & Alinhamentos: participar de reuniões de treinamento, análise de métricas e ajustes com Marketing focados em vendas;


  • Relatórios & KPIs: reportar KPIs por médico (semanal) e consolidado (mensal).


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em venda consultiva/inside sales (atuação ponta a ponta);
  • Disciplina de processo: domínio de follow-ups, contorno de objeções e negociação;
  • Infraestrutura remota: computador, internet estável headset (diferencial);


Diferenciais:


  • Vendas de procedimentos/cirurgias (saúde/estética);
  • Experiência em intermediação de hospitais e médicos; 
  • Kommo (ou similar), ClickUp e planilhas para relatórios;
  • Vivência com leads de tráfego pago e social selling


Pacote de Remuneração:


  • Modelo de contratação: PJ
  • Híbrido
  • Horário flexível -- aqui o que importa é atender com agilidade e eficiência
  • Pacote: R$2.000,00 (fixo) + Comissão por consulta agendada e comparecida + comissão por procedimento/cirurgia realizado
  • Oportunidade de crescimento na área dentro da Atem (função promissora)

  • Comercial 2 – Agendamentos e conclusão da venda : Agendar com hospitais e prestadores que participarão do procedimento;


  • Venda de Relacionamento: construir vínculo empático, educar sobre a jornada (sem promessas clínicas) e contornar objeções;


  • Follow-ups & Reativações: executar cadência estruturada (ligação/WhatsApp/e-mail) até a decisão; retomar orçamentos vencidos e no-shows;


  • CRM & Rotinas: operar o Kommo com funis separados por médico, tarefas, motivos de perda e previsibilidade; usar ClickUp/planilhas para controles específicos;

title: Data Architect
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados .

Mandatory skills:

1. Arquitetura & Modelagem de Dados

Modelagem multidimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake)

Data Warehouse e projetos complexos de modelagem

2. Engenharia de Dados em Cloud (AWS)

Criação e curadoria de pipelines

Serviços serverless (Spark, Glue, Lambda)

Formatos de tabela (Delta Lake, Iceberg)

3. Programação & Bancos de Dados

SQL avançado (Redshift, SQLDW, Postgres)

Stored Procedures, UDFs, ETL (Talend)

4. Infraestrutura & Orquestração

Kubernetes (obrigatório)

Terraform; Linux e sistemas distribuídos

5. CI/CD & Observabilidade

Jenkins, GitOps

Grafana, Kibana, Cloud Logging

6. Metodologias & Comunicação

Metodologias Ágeis

Inglês fluente

Key responsabilities:

  • Projetar e evoluir a arquitetura AWS Serverless DataLake, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e suporte a múltiplos workflows de dados.
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e enriquecimento usando AWS Lambda, Glue e serviços serverless correlatos.
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais para entender requisitos, priorizar entregas e garantir soluções de alta qualidade.
  • Mentorar engenheiros de dados mais juniores, promovendo boas práticas e desenvolvimento técnico.
  • Avaliar e adotar novos serviços AWS, buscando melhorias contínuas de performance, eficiência e inovação.
  • Monitorar e solucionar problemas do DataLake (performance, erros de processamento, infraestrutura).
  • Otimizar storage e acesso aos dados (S3, Athena, Redshift, DynamoDB) garantindo alta performance.
  • Definir modelos e esquemas de dados alinhados às necessidades de analistas e data scientists.
  • Atuar com tecnologias de orquestração de containers quando necessário (Kubernetes).

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
Blue Dot , headquartered in São Paulo, is a leading company in the Contact Center and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) segment, with over 10 years of international experience. Specialized in Staffing solutions for companies in the United States, we connect highly qualified talent in Brazil with global career opportunities.


Our operation is strategically located in one of the largest metropolitan areas in the world, allowing us to access a broad, diverse, and highly skilled workforce.


Value Package for the Professional


  • Compensation: R$ 3,500.00
  • Structured career plan: real opportunities for growth into leadership positions
  • Professional stability: permanent position with a long-term focus
  • Continuous development: regular technical and behavioral training
  • Multicultural and dynamic environment with international exposure


Mandatory Requirements


  • Fluent English (C1 or C2 level, both spoken and written) – will be assessed during the process
  • Clear, professional, and objective communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, productivity focus, and multitasking ability
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, project management tools, or automation tools
  • 1 year experience in related roles


General Job Information


  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, from 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM (Brasília time)
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Work model: 100% remote


Key Responsibilities


You will act as a strategic remote support professional for our clients in the United States, focusing on operational efficiency, service excellence, and commercial support. Responsibilities include:


Executive and Administrative Support


  • Managing calendars, meetings, and appointments
  • Handling corporate emails and preparing executive reports
  • Supporting administrative routines


International Recruitment


  • Sourcing and screening candidates for U.S.-based roles
  • Conducting cold calls, interviews, and follow-ups
  • Scheduling interviews and onboarding processes
  • Updating and maintaining databases


Commercial Support

  • Prospecting and qualifying leads
  • Conducting market research and interacting via CRM, email, and LinkedIn
  • Assisting with sales reports and forecasts


Customer Experience (CX)

  • Providing support via phone, email, and chat
  • Efficiently resolving customer requests
  • Collecting feedback and supporting retention strategies


Project Management (PMO)

  • Assisting with timelines, meetings, and task delegation
  • Updating documents and tracking deliverables
  • Supporting social media, content creation, and data entry


Accounts Receivable (Finance)

  • Issuing and sending invoices
  • Monitoring payments and tracking outstanding balances
  • Assisting in preparing financial reports


Desired Profile

  • Analytical, resilient, and strategic mindset
  • Ability to adapt to different demands and industries
  • Interest in building a long-term international career


How to Apply


Submit your application and become part of a team committed to excellence, connecting professionals with leading companies in the international market.


If you are selected to move forward in the process, we will contact you via LinkedIn.

Our operation is strategically located in one of the largest metropolitan areas in the world, allowing us to access a broad, diverse, and highly skilled workforce.


Value Package for the Professional


  • Compensation: R$ 3,500.00
  • Structured career plan: real opportunities for growth into leadership positions
  • Professional stability: permanent position with a long-term focus
  • Continuous development: regular technical and behavioral training
  • Multicultural and dynamic environment with international exposure


Mandatory Requirements


  • Fluent English (C1 or C2 level, both spoken and written) – will be assessed during the process
  • Clear, professional, and objective communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, productivity focus, and multitasking ability
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, project management tools, or automation tools
  • 1 year experience in related roles


General Job Information


  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, from 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM (Brasília time)
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Work model: 100% remote


Key Responsibilities


You will act as a strategic remote support professional for our clients in the United States, focusing on operational efficiency, service excellence, and commercial support. Responsibilities include:


Executive and Administrative Support


  • Managing calendars, meetings, and appointments
  • Handling corporate emails and preparing executive reports
  • Supporting administrative routines


International Recruitment


  • Sourcing and screening candidates for U.S.-based roles
  • Conducting cold calls, interviews, and follow-ups
  • Scheduling interviews and onboarding processes
  • Updating and maintaining databases


Commercial Support

  • Prospecting and qualifying leads
  • Conducting market research and interacting via CRM, email, and LinkedIn
  • Assisting with sales reports and forecasts


Customer Experience (CX)

  • Providing support via phone, email, and chat
  • Efficiently resolving customer requests
  • Collecting feedback and supporting retention strategies


Project Management (PMO)

  • Assisting with timelines, meetings, and task delegation
  • Updating documents and tracking deliverables
  • Supporting social media, content creation, and data entry


Accounts Receivable (Finance)

  • Issuing and sending invoices
  • Monitoring payments and tracking outstanding balances
  • Assisting in preparing financial reports


Desired Profile

  • Analytical, resilient, and strategic mindset
  • Ability to adapt to different demands and industries
  • Interest in building a long-term international career


How to Apply


Submit your application and become part of a team committed to excellence, connecting professionals with leading companies in the international market.


If you are selected to move forward in the process, we will contact you via LinkedIn.

title: Data Analyst
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,500 - $2,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join their team. This role will play a critical part in driving data-informed decision-making across their organization. The Data Analyst will be responsible for developing and maintaining business intelligence dashboards and structuring and evaluating holdout tests.


The ideal candidate has a strong analytical foundation, hands-on experience with BI tools, a solid understanding of experimentation methodologies (including incrementality and holdout testing), as well as strong communication skills to closely collaborate with executive-level stakeholders.


Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and distribute automated reports and dashboards across key business functions, including marketing, inventory management, merchandising, and pricing.
  • Assess creative performance using Motion to identify trends in content, formats, or products to improve their marketing mix.
  • Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests, ensuring statistical rigor and providing clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Partner with marketing and product teams to evaluate incremental lift and long-term impact using holdout and experimentation frameworks.
  • Monitor and evaluate business performance against established KPIs, identifying trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including marketing, product, finance, and sales—to understand data needs and proactively deliver insights that support business objectives.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting, experimentation, and analytical best practices.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • 1-3 years of professional experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience working with large and complex datasets.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data modeling).
  • Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods, including A/B testing, holdout testing, and experimental design.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in e-commerce, retail, or consumer brands is a plus


Work Schedule : US Pacific Standard Time


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing eCommerce brand setting new standards in digital marketing and customer acquisition.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Company Overview:Lean Tech is a rapidly expanding organization situated in Medellín, Colombia. We pride ourselves on possessing one of the most influential networks within software development and IT services for the entertainment, financial, and logistics sectors. Our corporate projections offer a multitude of opportunities for professionals to elevate their careers and experience substantial growth. Joining our team means engaging with expansive engineering teams across Latin America and the United States, contributing to cutting-edge developments in multiple industries.
Position Title:  Mid+ Site Reliability EngineerLocation: Remote - LATAM
What you will be doing:We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence across our SaaS platform. This role is critical in improving incident response, system observability, and performance optimization, while proactively preventing disruptions.As part of the Cloud Operations organization, you will lead post-incident investigations, implement preventative strategies, and partner with Engineering and Observability teams to enhance system resilience. You will also play a key role in building automation, improving time-to-resolution (TTR), and enabling a data-driven approach to reliability.
Requirements & Qualifications To excel in this role, you should possess:
  • Strong expertise in SRE practices, incident management, and production operations.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as:
    • New Relic
    • Datadog
    • Sumo Logic
    • or similar platforms
  • Proficiency in programming/scripting (e.g., JavaScript, .NET, SQL).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure acceptable).
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
    Experience troubleshooting C#/.NET web applications and performance issues.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with:
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Strong troubleshooting experience in:
    • Windows environments
    • SQL Server
  • Previous experience as a:
    • Software Engineer
    • System Administrator
Soft Skills:
  • Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
Why you will love Lean Tech:
  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. 
Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
