title: Customer Care Representative - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Customer Care Representative position involves joining the Recruiting Team to participate in different projects with multicultural teams distributed worldwide. This role requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional with excellent analytical abilities, teamwork skills, and multitasking capabilities to support recruitment processes in a fast-growing company.


Key responsibilities:


- Supporting the sourcing process including posting job openings on various job boards, headhunting, using social networks, filtering CVs, and contacting candidates.

- Understanding the requirements of each vacancy to carry out the headhunting process according to specific needs.


Requirements:


- Professional Experience: At least 1 year of work experience.

- Industry Knowledge: Understanding of the IT market.

- Communication: Excellent communication skills.

- Self-Management: Great capacity for independent work and self-direction.

- Education: Studies in Human Resources, Psychology, or related fields.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Executive Headhunter - Remote
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.


Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.


When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.


Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor at BairesDev


As a Senior Auditor , you'll play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and reliability of recruitment audits. You'll handle complex and high-impact cases, review and guide junior auditors, and help align evaluation criteria across the team. This role offers the chance to make a real impact by improving the quality of hiring processes, working on meaningful and complex cases, shaping audit standards, and helping both processes and people grow through clear feedback and continuous improvement.


What You'll Do:


- Execute complex, sensitive, and high-impact audits.

- Supervise and review Junior Auditors' evaluations.

- Lead calibration calls and standardize criteria across the audit team.


What we are looking for:


- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance roles.

- Proven experience auditing complex and high-impact roles, including senior profiles, closers, and specialized positions.

- Hands-on experience supervising and calibrating Junior Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy across evaluations.

- Advanced proficiency in English.


Nice to have:


- Experience in Talent Acquisition.

- Experience working with high-volume recruitment processes.

- Experience in data analysis and SQL.


How we do make your work (and your life) easier:


- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.


Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Analista de Orçamento e Desempenho
description:
Descrição da vaga

Orgulhosamente, somos um dos principais bancos do Brasil. Aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Estamos sempre em busca de melhorias, aprendizado contínuo e inovação. Procuramos pessoas que sejam apaixonadas por mudanças, que tenham vontade de aprender e queiram crescer no mercado financeiro. Se você se identifica, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão as atividades do dia a dia?


  • Elaborar, consolidar e acompanhar o Budget anual e os ciclos de Forecast .
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros como receitas, despesas, margem, eficiência operacional, ROE, ROA, entre outros essenciais ao setor financeiro.
  • Realizar análises de orçado x realizado , identificando causas e propondo ações corretivas.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico e definição de metas corporativas.
  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais , dashboards e apresentações executivas .
  • Criar projeções financeiras e simulações de cenários (sensibilidades, stress tests).
  • Suportar áreas de negócio no processo orçamentário.
  • Automatizar processos, controles e fluxos de análise, aumentando eficiência.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com Controladoria, Contabilidade, Tesouraria e demais áreas de negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos imprescindíveis:


Formação

  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação/MBA em Finanças ou Controladoria é desejável.


Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Planejamento financeiro, orçamento corporativo e análise de performance.
  • Análise de demonstrativos financeiros (DRE, Balanço, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Excel avançado (obrigatório).
  • Ferramentas de BI : Power BI, Tableau ou similares.
  • Databricks (manipulação de dados, pipelines e análises).
  • Lovable e demais assistentes de IA baseados em LLM voltados para automações, análises e aumento de produtividade.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia no setor bancário ou Financeiro
  • Conhecimento em regulamentação do Banco Central
  • Experiência com automação de relatórios (VBA, SQL, Python).

Informações adicionais


  • Vale-Refeição;
  • Vale-Alimentação;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Nascimento;
  • Auxílio Casamento;
  • Auxílio Creche/Babá;
  • Bônus Aniversário;
  • Apoio Pass;
  • Convênio Academia;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • PLR;
  • Bônus anual.

title: Content Moderator
description:
We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning talent network , and we are currently looking for a Content Reviewer to review and evaluate online content to help improve AI responses and overall accuracy. The role involves checking content quality, correctness, and proper categorization according to project guidelines.

If you enjoy working with data, pay close attention to detail, and want to contribute to real-world AI innovation, this is an excellent opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking global team.


Job Title: Content Reviewer

Location: Remote /Brazil

Type: Freelance

Required Engagement: 30 hours per week



Key Responsibilities:

• Review digital content and evaluate its quality and accuracy

• Help improve AI responses by providing accurate evaluations

• Follow project guidelines while reviewing content

• Identify errors, inconsistencies, or inappropriate content

• Categorize and tag content appropriately


Key Requirements:

• Good knowledge of pop culture, brands, and current events

• Understanding of taxonomy and content categorization

• Familiarity with social media platforms is mandatory

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills


Assessment Process:

Candidates will be required to complete the following assessments:

• LLM Evaluation Assessment

• Pearson Versant Assessment (C1/C2 only)

title: Analista de contabilidade Sênior
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contabilidade Sênior para integrar nossa equipe na Av. Paulista. Este cargo implica na análise e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras, conciliações, lançamentos contábeis e suporte às atividades financeiras da organização. O profissional será responsável por assegurar a conformidade com normativas contábeis e contribuir para a tomada de decisões estratégicas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.


Qualificações

  • Contabilidade e Finanças: Experiência em contabilidade geral, lançamento contábil e preparo de demonstrações financeiras. Conhecimento de práticas e regulamentações contábeis.
  • Análise de Dados: Habilidade analítica para interpretação de dados financeiros e geração de relatórios precisos que apoiem a tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência em registros financeiros: Domínio na elaboração e revisão de lançamentos contábeis e na análise de transações financeiras.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ERP (RM e Domínio) serão consideradas diferenciais.
  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis com registro ativo no CRC.

title: Consultor (a) Mainframe CPM - Remoto
description:
Skills Required:


  • Advanced English


  • Expertise with Thruput Manager software architecture and batch routing techniques for customer solutions


  • Expertise with gathering processing and analyzing SMF data for performance and capacity support


  • Expertise with MXG and SAS PDB processing


  • Expertise with SAS programming skills on open system platforms


  • Expertise managing applications running on Linux (preferably SAS/MXG applications)


  • Expertise with Linux BASH scripting


  • Expertise managing/developing SAS and MXG on Linux


  • Expertise with tools related to performance and tuning such as: RMF, Omegamon, TEPS, and Intellimagic


  • Expertise with WLM policy architecture and administration


  • System programming background with the understanding of mainframe architecture and application environment capacity and performance support


  • Clear understanding of statistical analysis using SMF data


  • Expertise around visual communications to highlight key analysis findings, how to resolve issues, how to meet technical/business requirements, and ultimately how to communicate solutions and recommendations to stakeholders and senior IT managers


  • The ability to translate business goals into resource usage criteria based on the management guidelines set forth


  • Exhibit soft skills exhibited when communicating and negotiating with our customers to help ensure the business functions and criteria are met appropriately with the guidelines set forth by our capacity and performance management group


Software/Hardware Required:


  • z/OS v2.4, JES2/NJE, TSO, ISPF, SDSF, SMF, RMF, WLM, DFHSM, RACF, VTAM, TCPIP
  • Omegamon Suite (MVS, CICS, MQ, DB2)
  • Thruput Manager, File-Aid, Xpediter, Strobe, iStrobe
  • ChangeMan, MXG, PKZIP, Syncsort, APM, OPSMVS, ESP
  • MS Office Suite and VISIO
  • QWS3270 Secure
  • SFTP
  • Linux Red Hat; WinSCP; MobaXterm; BASH; Linux security software (PAM/A2A)

title: Business Analysis Intern - Estágio
description:
ENVIE SEU CURRÍCULO EM INGLÊS | PLEASE, SUBMIT YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH


About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!


Know more: Keeta Website

Location: 100% on site - Morumbi, SP


Job Responsibilities

1. Support in writing business research analysis and summaries, focused market behaviour and competitive landscape, and provide local market knowledge to support management decision-making;

2. Conduct business operation data construction work, including but not limited to conducting primary and secondary market research, building dashboards out of extracted data, always focused on increasing team's efficiency by making information organized and accessible;

3. Support in formulating delivery business operation strategies, including experience management strategies, pricing strategies, allowance strategies, and quickly adjust strategies according to the needs of different business stages to help business rapid development.


Job Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program (Bachelor’s or Technologist) in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field with expected graduation between Dec 2026 and Dec 2027 ;
  • Language: English is mandatory.
  • Be sensitive to data and have strong data analysis capabilities;
  • Fast and dedicated learner, have a broad industry perspective, logical thinking capabilities, and possess a spirit of exploration and innovation;
  • Plus: Have internship experience in commercial analysis, operational excellence or data-related fields in industries such as management consulting, technology, O2O, e-commerce, and instant delivery


We hope to see you soon ;)

#Keeta #EatBetter #LiveBetter

title: Auxiliar de Geologia (Sondagem)
description:
Descrição do Cargo

Estamos à procura de Auxiliar de Geologia para atuar em nossa equipe em um Projeto localizado em Poços de Caldas, MG. As atividades do cargo incluem o suporte em coletas de amostras, registro de dados geológicos e sondagem a trado. O profissional também será responsável por operar equipamentos de campo e realizar medições em locais de trabalho.


Qualificações

  • Conhecimentos técnicos em geologia e mineração: Experiência em atividades externas, além de familiaridade com ferramentas e instrumentos utilizados no campo.
  • Habilidades práticas: Conhecimento básico em operação e manutenção de equipamentos de campo, além de disponibilidade para trabalho em ambientes externos.
  • Formação: Ensino médio completo, será considerado um diferencial noções em normas ambientais vigentes.
  • Outros diferenciais incluem a experiência prévia no setor de mineração e a capacidade de trabalhar em equipe com proatividade e organização.
